story: Google makes Tasks in Gemini free: it can call businesses, book appointments and pay via Google Pay

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Gemini can now call and book for you
segments.narration: Gemini can now call businesses and book appointments for you, free.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Google expands Tasks in Gemini
segments.narration: Google expanded Tasks in Gemini on November seventeenth, free to hundreds of millions of people.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Switch from Chat to Task mode
segments.narration: Switch Gemini from Chat to Task. It acts for you: calling, booking, paying with Google Pay.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Customers may send AI to book you
segments.point: Catch: texting needs a US number
segments.narration: Customers could send AI to call or book you. The catch: texting Gemini needs a U S number.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Test it, then tidy your booking info
segments.narration: Our take: test it on your errands first. Keep hours and booking details clear.
